gen.title: From Preserving the Union to a War for Freedom
gen.orderNote: Follow cause and effect as the text presents them

steps.label: prevent the secession
steps.quote: Initially, the Civil War between North and South was fought by the North to prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union.
steps.orderHint: Consider how each step made the next possible

steps.label: ending slavery was not a goal
steps.quote: ending slavery was not a goal of the war.
steps.orderHint: Consider how each step made the next possible

steps.label: That changed
steps.quote: That changed on September 22, 1862, when President Lincoln issued his Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation
steps.orderHint: Consider how each step made the next possible

steps.label: change the goals of the war
steps.quote: Lincoln’s bold step to change the goals of the war was a military measure
steps.orderHint: Consider how each step made the next possible

steps.label: fundamentally transform the character of the war
steps.quote: it did fundamentally transform the character of the war.
steps.orderHint: Consider how each step made the next possible

steps.label: acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy
steps.quote: the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
steps.orderHint: Consider how each step made the next possible
